We present AnyGameRenderer, a video-to-video generative renderer that turns such footage into high-quality visuals with characters, motion detail, and effects. Throughout, it keeps the layout, camera, and every entity's position and timing intact.   Our AnyGameRenderer generalizes across a wide range of genres that agents build, such as tower defense, auto-battlers, top-down survivors, turn-based battles, kart racing, and crowd runners.   AnyGameRenderer takes plain video as its game-state input, with no complex representations such as engine G-buffers, per-object class labels, or low-poly proxies. Gray blockouts, colored primitives, semantic maps, and wireframes all work as input.   It also preserves entity correspondence: group counts stay correct, and entities appear and disappear on the right frame.   We implement AnyGameRenderer by LoRA fine-tuning MiniMax-H3 ref2va, a 33B reference-video-conditioned video generation model. Training uses sim10k paired clips from three sources: (i) multi-stream rendering data from 38 agent-made games exported from GEAR, an AI game-creation tool; (ii) two-stream rendering data from Unreal Engine, with programmatically controlled crowds, count changes, and entity scales; and (iii) real gameplay recordings, with pairs reconstructed via 3D-box detection.   To evaluate the entity correspondence, we propose an entity-level benchmark of 59 held-out cases with 753 entities, scored against ground-truth boxes. Compared with the base model, AnyGameRenderer better preserves entity correspondence: temporal match rises from 50.9\% to 62.9\%, missed count changes fall from 34.7\% to 21.3\%, and fewer entities are hallucinated or left unrendered.

ru.title: Из серых кубиков — в красивую игру, не теряя ни одного персонажа
ru.desc: Статья представляет AnyGameRenderer — генеративную модель video-to-video, которая превращает простые видео игр, созданных AI-агентами, в визуально качественные ролики. Модель сохраняет раскладку, камеру и позиции с таймингом всех сущностей, принимая на вход даже серые блокауты или wireframe. Она дообучена через LoRA на базе 33B-модели MiniMax-H3 ref2va на парных данных из игр, Unreal Engine и реальных записей геймплея. Оценка по собственному entity-level benchmark показывает рост temporal match с 50.9% до 62.9% и снижение пропущенных изменений количества сущностей.

en.title: Transforming Game Footage into High-Fidelity Visuals
en.desc: AnyGameRenderer is a generative model that enhances low-quality game footage into high-quality visuals while maintaining the original layout and timing of game elements. It allows AI coding agents to create playable games quickly, transforming basic graphics into detailed animations and effects. The model works with simple video inputs, avoiding complex representations, and ensures that the number and timing of game entities are accurately represented. By fine-tuning a large video generation model, AnyGameRenderer significantly improves entity correspondence and visual fidelity across various game genres.

zh.title: AnyGameRenderer：将低质量游戏视频转化为高保真视觉效果
zh.desc: AnyGameRenderer是一种视频到视频的生成模型，可以将低质量的游戏视频转换为高保真的视觉效果，同时保持布局、相机和实体的时间同步。该模型能够处理多种游戏类型，包括塔防、自动战斗和赛车等，输入可以是简单的视频，而不需要复杂的表示。通过对MiniMax-H3模型进行LoRA微调，AnyGameRenderer在训练中使用了来自多个来源的配对视频片段。与基础模型相比，AnyGameRenderer在保持实体对应性方面表现更好，时间匹配率和实体计数的准确性都有显著提升。

papers.title: AgentVQA: A Unified Benchmark for Agentic Visual Understanding
papers.abstract: Abstract AgentVQA is an offline benchmark assessing vision-language models on realistic agentic tasks across web, robotics, video, games, and spatial planning, revealing that visual grounding and state tracking errors are the primary failure modes.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Vision-language models (VLMs) can perform a broad range of tasks across diverse settings, yet their performance in agentic contexts remains poorly understood. Although online evaluations in simulators and real-world environments are essential for measuring interactive agent performance, they are costly and challenging to scale. Complementary offline VQA benchmarks can enable faster and more reliable comparisons across agentic domains, yet existing benchmarks remain limited and fragmented. To address this gap, we introduce AgentVQA, an offline benchmark for evaluating VLMs on realistic agentic scenarios across five agent domains: Web Agents, Robotics, Egocentric Videos, Games, and Spatial Planning. We build AgentVQA by manually selecting 1000 challenging, real-world agent examples from 23 source datasets and adapting them for reliable offline evaluation. The resulting benchmark preserves realistic scenarios from interactive environments across diverse domains, and its model rankings track those from corresponding online evaluations. Across the 22 evaluated models, the best achieves only 58.5% accuracy. Our cross-domain analysis shows that errors are driven primarily by failures to ground and maintain accurate representations of the current and evolving visual state, including localizing relevant UI elements, interpreting motion, tracking state changes over time, and inferring 3D spatial relationships, rather than by task misinterpretation or downstream logical reasoning.

ru.title: VLM-агентам не хватает зрения: ошибки в понимании состояния сцены, а не в логике
ru.desc: В статье представлен AgentVQA — оффлайн-бенчмарк для оценки vision-language моделей (VLM) на реалистичных агентных задачах в пяти доменах: веб-агенты, робототехника, egocentric-видео, игры и пространственное планирование. Авторы вручную отобрали 1000 сложных примеров из 23 датасетов, адаптировав их для надёжной оффлайн-оценки, при этом рейтинги моделей совпадают с онлайн-оценками в симуляторах. Лучшая из 22 протестированных моделей достигает лишь 58.5% точности. Анализ ошибок показывает, что главные причины — неспособность к visual grounding и отслеживанию состояния визуальной сцены, а не неверное понимание задачи или логические рассуждения.

en.title: AgentVQA: Benchmarking Vision-Language Models for Realistic Agent Tasks
en.desc: AgentVQA is a new offline benchmark designed to evaluate vision-language models (VLMs) on realistic tasks that require agent-like behavior across various domains such as robotics and gaming. The benchmark highlights that the main issues with VLMs are related to visual grounding and state tracking, which are crucial for understanding and interacting with dynamic environments. By using a curated set of 1000 challenging examples from multiple datasets, AgentVQA allows for consistent and reliable assessments of model performance without the high costs of online evaluations. The findings indicate that improving visual state representation is essential for enhancing the effectiveness of VLMs in agentic tasks.

zh.title: AgentVQA：评估视觉语言模型的新基准
zh.desc: AgentVQA是一个离线基准，用于评估视觉语言模型在现实代理任务中的表现，包括网络、机器人、视频、游戏和空间规划等领域。研究发现，视觉定位和状态跟踪错误是主要的失败模式。虽然在线评估在模拟器和现实环境中对交互代理性能的测量至关重要，但其成本高且难以扩展。AgentVQA通过从23个数据集中手动选择1000个具有挑战性的真实代理示例，提供了一个可靠的离线评估基准，能够更快、更可靠地比较不同代理领域的模型表现。

papers.title: MolLean: A Process-Verifiable Language for Chemical Reasoning
papers.abstract: Abstract MolLean introduces a verifiable chemical reasoning framework with explicit molecular states, Lean-based verification, and interactive tool feedback to reduce hallucinations across generation and reaction tasks.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Chemical chain-of-thought can contain hallucinated structural and property claims. We thereby introduce MolLean, a process-verifiable language that grounds chemical reasoning in an explicit molecular state. A layered Lean-based kernel checks state transitions and assertions over molecular readouts, from primitive graph edits to compound transformations. Meanwhile, a typed witness protocol separates native structural checks from externally supplied measurements. We further introduce MolLean-MCP, a stateful tool interface that exposes these transitions, checks, and readouts during generation: the model receives feedback to decide its next action, and rejected actions leave the state unchanged. MolLean supports one-pass trace execution, whole-trace refinement, and interactive reasoning through MolLean-MCP. We evaluate these three modes with direct chain-of-thought on 8,800 matched examples across 12 tasks spanning molecular generation, editing, optimization, and reactions. With Qwen3.6-27B, whole-trace refinement outperforms direct chain-of-thought on all 12 tasks. MolLean-MCP complements whole-trace refinement with stepwise verification feedback, reaching better performance in reaction tasks. Together, these results highlight an executable foundation for chemical reasoning, in which explicit chemical commitments can be checked and revised rather than remaining solely in free-form explanations.

ru.title: Химические рассуждения, которые можно проверить и исправить
ru.desc: Статья представляет MolLean — фреймворк для верифицируемых химических рассуждений, в котором явное молекулярное состояние проверяется ядром на основе Lean. Языковая модель (LLM) получает обратную связь через интерфейс MolLean-MCP и может пошагово исправлять свои действия, а отклонённые шаги не меняют состояние. Эксперименты на 8800 примерах и 12 задачах с моделью Qwen3.6-27B показали, что уточнение всей цепочки рассуждений (whole-trace refinement) превосходит прямой chain-of-thought, а MCP-режим дополнительно улучшает результаты в реакционных задачах. Подход уменьшает галлюцинации в химических утверждениях и делает рассуждения проверяемыми, а не только описательными.

en.title: MolLean: Verifiable Chemical Reasoning for Accurate Molecular Insights
en.desc: MolLean is a new framework designed to improve chemical reasoning by using explicit molecular states and verification methods. It employs a Lean-based kernel to ensure that state transitions and assertions about molecular properties are accurate, reducing the chances of generating incorrect information, known as hallucinations. The framework includes a tool called MolLean-MCP that provides interactive feedback during the generation process, allowing the model to refine its actions based on verification results. Evaluations show that MolLean significantly enhances performance in various chemical tasks by enabling precise checks and revisions of molecular claims.

zh.title: MolLean：可验证的化学推理框架
zh.desc: MolLean 是一个可验证的化学推理框架，旨在减少生成和反应任务中的幻觉现象。它通过明确的分子状态和基于 Lean 的验证来实现这一目标，并提供交互式工具反馈。MolLean 采用分层的 Lean 核心，检查分子状态的转变和属性声明，确保推理过程的准确性。通过 MolLean-MCP 接口，模型可以在生成过程中获得反馈，从而优化其决策，提升在化学生成、编辑和反应任务中的表现。

papers.title: Inherited, Not Invented: Tracing the Provenance of Wait in Reasoning Models
papers.abstract: Abstract Reinforcement learning improves reasoning accuracy without requiring a specific wait marker, which originates from training data rather than RL, and automated evaluation metrics can misrepresent reasoning trends.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Reinforcement learning (RL) is credited with teaching reasoning models to write {wait} before reconsidering a step, yet large RL accuracy gains do not require the word. This view can confuse what RL discovers with what a model inherits from its training data. We trace the word through open models' training histories, reading it with label-free indices of frequency, position, form and usage and an injected-error test, all computed from sampled outputs. We find that zero-RL almost never coins the marker: on bases that lack the word, RL raises MATH-500 accuracy substantially while {wait} stays near absent. It arrives with training data: mid-training in OLMo-3, and fine-tuning on reasoning traces installs it in most models whose base lacks it. Where the base already uses it, both released RL-Zero recipes (OLMo-3, MiMo) multiply it, whereas KL-free GRPO from the same base does not; OLMo-3's recipe wears down its form and makes it a more sensitive but more liberal alarm; RL after supervised fine-tuning barely changes it, and our GRPO recipe erases a marker seeded by fine-tuning. Finally, we show that marker frequency alone does not indicate RL-induced reasoning and caution against LLM-as-a-judge revision metrics, as automated judges can reverse human-labelled trends.
affiliations: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

ru.title: RL учит рассуждать, а слово «wait» приходит из данных
ru.desc: В статье показано, что слово «wait», которое часто связывают с обучением рассуждениям через RL, на самом деле почти не возникает в zero-RL, а приходит из обучающих данных (mid-training и fine-tuning на reasoning traces). Авторы анализируют частоту, позицию, форму и контекст маркера в выходах сэмплированных моделей, а также проверяют его через тест с внедрёнными ошибками. Показано, что RL повышает точность на MATH-500 даже без этого слова, а рецепты обучения по-разному усиливают или стирают маркер. Наконец, авторы предостерегают, что частота маркера не доказывает наличие рассуждений, а LLM-as-a-judge метрики могут искажать выводы.

en.title: Reinforcement Learning: Enhancing Reasoning Beyond Markers
en.desc: This paper explores how reinforcement learning (RL) can enhance reasoning accuracy in models without relying on specific markers like 'wait'. It highlights that significant improvements in accuracy can occur even when these markers are absent from the training data. The authors analyze the training histories of various models to understand the relationship between RL and the emergence of these markers. They caution against using automated evaluation metrics, as they may misrepresent the reasoning capabilities of models by not accurately reflecting the influence of RL.

zh.title: 强化学习提升推理准确性，无需特定标记
zh.desc: 强化学习（RL）可以提高推理模型的准确性，而不需要特定的等待标记。研究表明，RL的准确性提升并不依赖于训练数据中的某个特定词汇。我们通过分析开放模型的训练历史，发现零强化学习几乎从未使用该标记。最终，我们警告说，仅仅依赖标记频率并不能准确反映RL引发的推理变化。

papers.title: F2G-Pose: Geometry-Aware Foundation Feature Lifting for Direct RGB-D Category-Level Object Pose Estimation
papers.abstract: Abstract F2G-Pose is a real-time feed-forward framework that predicts category-level object pose, metric size, and completed shape from a single RGB-D image using dense visual features, DGCNN tokenization, and a Mixture-of-Experts Transformer.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small This paper studies category-level RGB-D object pose estimation, which recovers an object's 3D rotation and translation without instance-specific CAD models or reference views. This task is highly ambiguous due to intra-class variations, symmetries, and partial observations. Current solutions struggle to balance reliability and efficiency: methods based on intermediate structures are prone to error propagation, while diffusion models suffer from high inference latency and complex post-hoc candidate extraction. To address this, we present F2G-Pose, a real-time direct, single-pass framework that predicts category-level pose, metric size, and camera-frame completed shape from a single RGB-D observation in one feed-forward pass. F2G-Pose lifts dense visual foundation features to partial point clouds, encodes local geometry with DGCNN tokenization, and integrates object-level structure with a Mixture-of-Experts Transformer. Joint size prediction and camera-frame shape completion encourage metric consistency through dense geometric supervision. With its task-specific network trained only on pose-annotated synthetic SOPE data and its frozen RADIO backbone externally pretrained, F2G-Pose achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on SOPE and ROPE while running at 28 FPS for pose-only inference, and further demonstrates strong camera-frame geometry on HouseCat6D and real-object transfer on HANDAL. Analyses of latency, robustness, shape completion, and GenPose++ candidate behavior further demonstrate the efficiency and reliability of F2G-Pose, with real-world manipulation experiments demonstrating deployment potential under segmented RGB-D inputs. The project page, code, and pretrained models are made available at https://jrryzh.github.io/F2G-Pose/.

ru.title: Поза объекта за один проход: быстро, точно и в реальном времени
ru.desc: В статье представлен F2G-Pose — быстрый однопроходный фреймворк для оценки позы объекта на уровне категории по одному RGB-D изображению. Модель предсказывает 3D-вращение и трансляцию, метрический размер и полную форму объекта в системе координат камеры без использования CAD-моделей. Для этого признаки из замороженного RADIO backbone переносятся на частичные облака точек, локальная геометрия кодируется через DGCNN tokenization, а глобальный контекст объекта обрабатывается Mixture-of-Experts Transformer. Метод достигает state-of-the-art точности на SOPE и ROPE при скорости около 28 FPS.

en.title: Real-Time Object Pose Estimation with F2G-Pose
en.desc: F2G-Pose is a novel framework designed for real-time category-level object pose estimation from a single RGB-D image. It utilizes dense visual features and a Mixture-of-Experts Transformer to predict an object's 3D pose, size, and shape without needing specific CAD models. The framework addresses challenges like intra-class variations and partial observations, achieving high accuracy while maintaining efficiency at 28 frames per second. By leveraging a task-specific network trained on synthetic data, F2G-Pose demonstrates strong performance in both simulated and real-world scenarios.

zh.title: 实时物体姿态估计的新突破
zh.desc: F2G-Pose 是一个实时的前馈框架，能够从单个 RGB-D 图像中预测类别级别的物体姿态、度量大小和完整形状。该方法利用密集视觉特征、DGCNN 令牌化和专家混合变换器，解决了物体姿态估计中的模糊性问题。与现有方法相比，F2G-Pose 在保持高效性的同时，显著提高了可靠性，避免了错误传播和高延迟的问题。通过在合成数据上训练的任务特定网络，F2G-Pose 在多个基准测试中达到了最先进的准确性，并展示了在实际应用中的潜力。

papers.title: SCOPE: Compiling Natural-Language Policies into Neurosymbolic Predicate Programs
papers.abstract: Abstract SCOPE compiles compound policies into optimized neural-symbolic programs that achieve high accuracy, stability, and interpretability on inexpensive models.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Policy enforcement for LLM agents has shifted from single-turn content moderation to compound, application-specific policies evaluated over multi-turn transcripts and tool-call trajectories. Fine-tuned guardrail models are efficient but degrade on compound policies, and while LLM-as-a-judge approaches achieve higher accuracy, they incur high inference cost and tend to produce unstable predictions. Neurosymbolic methods offer a natural alternative, decomposing the policy into narrow neural decisions composed under explicit logic. However, existing symbolic layers lack the required expressiveness and are optimized against fixed data rather than the policy itself. To address this, we introduce SCOPE, which compiles a policy into an executable program of neural predicates executed by small models, deterministic extractors, and code that composes their outputs. The program is optimized jointly with its training data, using adversarial generation of counterexamples that target where the program deviates from the policy. We evaluate SCOPE on a benchmark of real-world policy tasks against prompt optimization, task decomposition, and workflow generation methods, achieving the highest average accuracy across tasks and models. Programs optimized with the weakest executor transfer to other models without further optimization. This allows them to be deployed in production on inexpensive models, where they reach accuracy comparable to frontier reasoning models. Unlike these monolithic models, SCOPE produces substantially more stable predictions, and each verdict is interpretable through the predicate outputs that produced it. Additionally, we validate the key components of our method through an ablation study. SCOPE thus enables reliable, interpretable, and efficient policy enforcement at production scale.

ru.title: Компилируем политики безопасности LLM-агентов в надёжные и понятные программы
ru.desc: В статье представлен SCOPE — метод, который компилирует составную политику безопасности в исполняемую нейросимволическую программу из нейронных предикатов, детерминированных экстракторов и кода, объединяющего их выходы. Программа оптимизируется совместно с обучающими данными, а для поиска слабых мест используется состязательная генерация контрпримеров, где программа расходится с политикой. На реальных задачах SCOPE показывает наивысшую среднюю точность среди методов оптимизации промптов, декомпозиции задач и генерации воркфлоу. Благодаря высокой стабильности предсказаний и интерпретируемости вердиктов такие программы можно эффективно разворачивать на дешёвых моделях в продакшене.

en.title: Optimizing Policies with Neural-Symbolic Programs for Better Accuracy and Interpretability
en.desc: The paper introduces SCOPE, a method that transforms complex policies into optimized neural-symbolic programs for better performance in machine learning tasks. It addresses the limitations of existing models by combining neural networks with explicit logic, allowing for more accurate and stable predictions. SCOPE is designed to work efficiently with smaller models, making it cost-effective while maintaining high accuracy comparable to larger models. The approach also enhances interpretability, as each decision can be traced back to the specific logic used in the program.

zh.title: SCOPE：高效、可解释的复合策略执行
zh.desc: SCOPE 是一种将复合策略编译成优化的神经符号程序的方法，能够在低成本模型上实现高准确性、稳定性和可解释性。该方法通过将策略分解为明确逻辑下的狭窄神经决策，克服了现有符号层的表达能力不足的问题。SCOPE 通过对抗生成反例来优化程序，使其与训练数据共同优化，从而在真实世界的政策任务基准测试中表现出色。与传统的单一模型相比，SCOPE 提供了更稳定的预测结果，并且每个判决都可以通过生成的谓词输出进行解释。

papers.title: Reading, Writing, Sharing, and Interacting with the World through Video
papers.abstract: Abstract This survey unifies video understanding and generation through world modeling, organizing progress around inferring, synthesizing, sharing, and interacting with latent temporal states to emphasize persistent dynamics over clip-level perception.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Video foundation models have advanced rapidly in understanding and generating visual sequences, while video world models seek to capture the underlying dynamics of the world they depict. Despite their different objectives, both concern the relationship between video observations and an evolving world. This survey adopts world modeling as a unifying lens for examining these developments. Viewing an observed video as a partial, lossy, and temporally ordered projection of a latent temporal world, we organize the literature around four complementary operations: reading infers world properties from observed video; writing synthesizes video from specified or learned world conditions; sharing integrates understanding and generation through common modeling mechanisms; and interacting predicts and updates world states under actions and evolving observations. This perspective distinguishes temporal coherence in observed or generated sequences from consistency in the underlying world state. Across tasks, representations, models, datasets, and benchmarks, we trace a shift in emphasis from clip-level recognition and perceptual fidelity toward persistent state, controllable evolution, physical and causal validity, and evaluation grounded in interaction and downstream decisions, and we distill the open challenges that follow.

ru.title: Видео — это проекция мира: от распознавания кадров к моделированию его динамики
ru.desc: Обзор объединяет понимание и генерацию видео через призму world modeling, то есть моделирования латентного временного мира, который лежит за наблюдаемыми кадрами. Авторы выделяют четыре операции: чтение (inference свойств мира из видео), запись (синтез видео по условиям мира), совместное использование общих механизмов и взаимодействие, при котором предсказываются и обновляются состояния мира под действиями. Главный сдвиг фокуса — от распознавания отдельных клипов и перцептивного качества к устойчивому состоянию, управляемой эволюции, физической и каUsальной корректности. В работе также разбираются датасеты, бенчмарки и открытые проблемы, включая оценку через взаимодействие и последующие решения.

en.title: Unifying Video Understanding and Generation through World Modeling
en.desc: This paper surveys the integration of video understanding and generation through the concept of world modeling. It highlights how video foundation models and video world models both aim to understand the dynamics of the world depicted in videos, despite having different goals. The authors categorize the literature into four key operations: reading, writing, sharing, and interacting, which focus on inferring world properties, synthesizing video, integrating understanding, and predicting world states. The paper emphasizes a shift from merely recognizing clips to understanding persistent states and their evolution, while also identifying ongoing challenges in the field.

zh.title: 视频理解与生成的统一视角
zh.desc: 这篇论文调查了视频理解和生成的统一，通过世界建模来组织进展。它强调了持久动态而非片段级感知，关注视频观察与不断变化的世界之间的关系。论文将文献分为四个互补操作：读取、写入、共享和交互，以探讨如何从观察到的视频推断世界属性、合成视频、整合理解与生成，以及在行动和观察变化下预测和更新世界状态。最后，论文总结了从片段级识别向持久状态和可控演变的转变，以及在交互和下游决策中评估的开放挑战。

papers.title: What Makes a Good Unmasking Policy? A Controlled Study of Learned Unmasking in Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract: Abstract Optimized unmasking policies for masked diffusion language models improve efficiency by using trajectory-contraction targets with confidence and hidden states, achieving better speed-accuracy trade-offs with minimal overhead.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Masked diffusion language models generate tokens in parallel, but their efficiency depends on which predictions are committed. Learned unmasking policies improve the speed--accuracy trade-off, yet differ in supervision, inputs, and capacity, obscuring which choices matter. We view supervised policies as distilling a decoding procedure through a teacher and examine independently what the teacher labels as committable, on which states the policy imitates it, what the policy observes, and how much the number of function evaluations (NFE) must decrease to offset policy overhead. We find that labeling predictions matching the final output is overly permissive at low NFE, and hidden states are weak alone but can complement confidence. About a 10% NFE reduction suffices to offset policy overhead for policies up to 7.5M parameters across tested settings. We therefore train a policy on trajectory-contraction targets, which accept only commitments staying on a reference trajectory, using confidence and hidden states. On LLaDA-8B-Instruct, the resulting 856K-parameter policy achieves the best accuracy--NFE frontier and highest throughput on GSM8K, is competitive at moderate targets on MATH-500 and HumanEval, and largely transfers to Dream-7B-Instruct.

Institute for Advanced Intelligence and Computing (IAIC), A*STAR

ru.title: Фиксировать только то, что остаётся на траектории: быстрее декодирование без потери точности
ru.desc: Статья посвящена оптимизации порядка декодирования в masked diffusion языковых моделях, где токены генерируются параллельно, а эффективность зависит от того, какие предсказания фиксируются на каждом шаге. Авторы рассматривают обученную политику разметки (unmasking policy) как дистилляцию процедуры декодирования учителя и разделяют её компоненты: правила разметки, состояния, которые она имитирует, входные признаки и ёмкость модели. Выяснилось, что простое совпадение предсказаний с финальным ответом слишком мягко при малом числе вычислений, а скрытые состояния слабы сами по себе, но дополняют уверенность модели. Предложенная политика с 856K параметров, обученная на целях trajectory-contraction с признаками confidence и hidden states, даёт лучший баланс точности и NFE на GSM8K и переносится на Dream-7B-Instruct.

en.title: Optimizing Efficiency in Masked Diffusion Models
en.desc: This paper discusses improvements in masked diffusion language models by optimizing unmasking policies. These policies enhance efficiency by using trajectory-contraction targets, which help balance speed and accuracy with minimal additional costs. The authors analyze how different supervision methods and inputs affect the performance of these policies, particularly focusing on the importance of confidence and hidden states. Their findings indicate that a well-trained policy can significantly reduce function evaluations while maintaining high accuracy, leading to better overall performance in various tasks.

zh.title: 优化去掩蔽策略提升语言模型效率
zh.desc: 这篇论文探讨了优化的去掩蔽策略在掩蔽扩散语言模型中的应用，旨在提高效率。通过使用轨迹收缩目标和置信度，研究者们实现了更好的速度与准确性之间的平衡。论文指出，学习的去掩蔽策略在监督、输入和容量上存在差异，这使得选择的重要性变得模糊。最终，研究表明，通过训练一个基于轨迹收缩目标的策略，可以显著减少功能评估次数，从而提高模型的整体性能。

papers.title: Foundation4D: Towards a unified perception and reconstruction model for autonomous vehicles
papers.abstract: Abstract Foundation4D is a unified feed-forward model that jointly estimates geometry, detects objects, predicts semantic occupancy, and reconstructs Gaussians from multi-camera driving video, achieving state-of-the-art results across several benchmarks.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small We introduce Foundation4D, a unified feed-forward model for geometry estimation, 3D detection, semantic occupancy, and Gaussian reconstruction from multi-camera driving video. A shared backbone uses factorized spatiotemporal attention to efficiently combine observations across cameras and time. Our video inference pipeline uses pose graph optimization to refine camera trajectories and assembles object tracks across input windows. We also develop a data annotation pipeline and release PAI-Foundation4D, a benchmark with dense depth and semantic occupancy labels for 1,253 driving clips. With benchmark-specific fine-tuning, Foundation4D achieves the lowest depth AbsRel on Waymo and nuScenes, the highest detection mAP on nuScenes, and the highest occupancy mIoU on OpenOccupancy among the compared methods. Our task-combination study shows benefits for both detection and geometry: co-training detection with geometry and occupancy improves top-class mAP by 1.2 points over detection-only training, while co-training geometry with detection reduces camera-to-rig translation error by 13.4% relative to geometry-only training. We further use the predicted geometry and trajectories as priors for lidarless NuRec, supporting reconstruction of driving scenes for simulation.

ru.title: Одна модель для геометрии, объектов и 3D-сцены по видео с камер авто
ru.desc: Foundation4D — это единая feed-forward модель, которая одновременно оценивает геометрию сцены, детектирует объекты, предсказывает семантическую occupancy и реконструирует Gaussians по видео с нескольких камер автомобиля. Общий backbone с факторизованным spatiotemporal attention эффективно объединяет наблюдения между камерами и во времени, а pose graph optimization уточняет траектории камеры и собирает треки объектов. Авторы также выпустили датасет PAI-Foundation4D с плотными разметками глубины и semantic occupancy для 1253 клипов. Совместное обучение детекции с геометрией и occupancy повышает mAP, а предсказанная геометрия служит приором для lidarless NuRec-реконструкции сцен для симуляции.

en.title: Unified Model for Enhanced 3D Understanding in Driving Videos
en.desc: Foundation4D is a comprehensive machine learning model that integrates multiple tasks such as geometry estimation, object detection, semantic occupancy prediction, and Gaussian reconstruction from driving videos captured by multiple cameras. It employs a shared backbone with factorized spatiotemporal attention to effectively merge data from different cameras and time frames. The model's performance is enhanced through a video inference pipeline that optimizes camera trajectories and consolidates object tracking across various input segments. By fine-tuning on specific benchmarks, Foundation4D achieves leading results in depth estimation, object detection, and occupancy prediction, demonstrating the advantages of co-training different tasks for improved accuracy.

zh.title: Foundation4D：多任务联合学习的前沿模型
zh.desc: Foundation4D 是一个统一的前馈模型，能够同时估计几何形状、检测物体、预测语义占用和从多摄像头驾驶视频中重建高斯分布。该模型通过一个共享的骨干网络，利用分解的时空注意力高效地结合来自不同摄像头和时间的观察数据。我们还开发了数据标注管道，并发布了 PAI-Foundation4D 基准数据集，包含 1,253 个驾驶片段的密集深度和语义占用标签。通过基准特定的微调，Foundation4D 在多个基准测试中取得了最先进的结果，显示了检测与几何形状联合训练的优势。

papers.title: TILDE: Teacher-in-the-Loop Distillation from Embodied Foundation Models
papers.abstract: Abstract TILDE distills embodied foundation model capabilities into robot policies via on-policy teacher supervision and autonomous recovery data collection, improving real-world task performance without large-scale action pretraining.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Large-scale action pretraining equips Embodied Foundation Models (EFMs) with strong manipulation capabilities, with particular strengths in generalization and closed-loop robustness, but reproducing such pretraining requires substantial robot data and computation. To transfer these capabilities from pretrained EFMs to policies without action pretraining, we introduce TILDE (Teacher-In-the-Loop Distillation from EFMs), which synergizes on-policy distillation at student-induced states with learning from teacher-executed recovery trajectories. We further propose AutoDAgger, an autonomous data aggregation pipeline in which a robotic reward model is utilized to monitor task progress and trigger teacher intervention, thereby collecting recovery experience without human monitoring or manual control. AutoDAgger accelerates recovery-trajectory collection by more than 2times compared with the human-in-the-loop method. By unifying learning from demonstrations, on-policy teacher supervision, and teacher's corrective behavior, TILDE improves task performance by up to 4.1times over behavior cloning across three real-world tasks and supports effective cross-architecture distillation.

ru.title: Учитель в цикле: роботы учатся на ошибках и восстанавливаются сами
ru.desc: В статье представлен метод TILDE, который переносит возможности предобученных Embodied Foundation Models (EFM) в политики роботов без дорогостоящего предобучения на действиях. Ключевая идея сочетает on-policy дистилляцию на состояниях, порождённых самим студентом, с обучением на траекториях восстановления, выполненных учителем. Для сбора таких траекторий предложен AutoDAgger, в котором робототехническая reward model автоматически отслеживает прогресс задачи и запускает вмешательство учителя без участия человека. Метод ускоряет сбор данных более чем в 2 раза и улучшает качество выполнения задач до 4.1 раза по сравнению с behavior cloning на трёх реальных задачах.

en.title: Enhancing Robot Learning with TILDE: Efficient Knowledge Transfer Without Extensive Pretraining
en.desc: The paper introduces TILDE, a method that enhances robot policies by leveraging the capabilities of Embodied Foundation Models (EFMs) without the need for extensive action pretraining. TILDE employs on-policy teacher supervision and collects autonomous recovery data to improve real-world task performance. It also features AutoDAgger, a system that uses a robotic reward model to efficiently gather recovery experiences, significantly speeding up data collection. Overall, TILDE demonstrates a substantial increase in task performance and supports effective knowledge transfer across different robotic architectures.

zh.title: TILDE：提升机器人任务表现的新方法
zh.desc: TILDE是一种新方法，它通过教师监督和自主数据收集，将具身基础模型的能力转化为机器人策略，从而提高实际任务的表现，而无需大规模的动作预训练。该方法结合了在学生诱导状态下的在线蒸馏和教师执行的恢复轨迹学习。我们还提出了AutoDAgger，一个自主数据聚合管道，利用机器人奖励模型监控任务进展并触发教师干预，从而在没有人工监控的情况下收集恢复经验。通过统一演示学习、在线教师监督和教师的纠正行为，TILDE在三个实际任务中将任务表现提高了多达4.1倍。

papers.title: SEAM: Spectral Embedding Alignment and Merging for Low-Resource TTS
papers.abstract: Abstract SEAM initializes unseen token embeddings from subtokens via spectral filtering and ridge regression, reducing training data needs by 75% for low-resource text-to-speech vocabulary expansion.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Expanding the vocabulary of conditional text-to-speech (TTS) models typically requires extensive fine-tuning with paired audio, creating a major bottleneck for low-resource and cross-lingual adaptation. To address this, we introduce SEAM, a zero-audio initialization method that constructs embeddings for unseen tokens from known subtokens. Unlike standard pooling strategies that ignore sequential structure, SEAM applies a spectral filter to preserve temporal phonetic order and uses closed-form ridge regression to align the new embeddings with the pretrained conditioning manifold. Across three languages and two TTS architectures, SEAM approaches or matches baseline performance using up to four times less training data, reducing sample complexity by 75\% compared to random initialization and mean pooling. Our approach provides a lightweight, reproducible, and theoretically grounded solution for vocabulary expansion in low-resource speech synthesis.

ru.title: Новые слова для синтеза речи без аудио: меньше данных, та же точность
ru.desc: В статье представлен метод SEAM для расширения словаря моделей синтеза речи (TTS) без аудиоданных. Новые токены получают эмбеддинги из уже известных субтокенов с помощью спектрального фильтра, который сохраняет порядок фонетических единиц, и ridge regression в замкнутой форме, выравнивающей их с предобученным conditioning manifold. На трёх языках и двух архитектурах TTS SEAM достигает качества базовой модели, используя до четырёх раз меньше обучающих данных, что снижает sample complexity на 75% по сравнению со случайной инициализацией и mean pooling. Подход легковесен, воспроизводим и теоретически обоснован, что делает его удобным решением для low-resource синтеза речи.

en.title: SEAM: Efficient Vocabulary Expansion for TTS with Minimal Data
en.desc: The paper introduces SEAM, a novel method for initializing token embeddings in text-to-speech (TTS) systems without requiring paired audio data. By utilizing spectral filtering and ridge regression, SEAM effectively constructs embeddings for unseen tokens from known subtokens, preserving the phonetic order. This approach significantly reduces the amount of training data needed by 75%, making it particularly beneficial for low-resource and cross-lingual TTS applications. The results demonstrate that SEAM can achieve performance comparable to traditional methods while requiring much less data, thus addressing a key challenge in speech synthesis.

zh.title: SEAM：低资源语音合成的高效词汇扩展方法
zh.desc: SEAM是一种用于扩展文本到语音（TTS）模型词汇的方法，它通过光谱过滤和岭回归从已知的子词生成未见词的嵌入。这种方法减少了对配对音频的需求，使得低资源环境下的词汇扩展变得更加高效。与传统的池化策略不同，SEAM保留了时间上的音素顺序，从而提高了嵌入的质量。通过在三种语言和两种TTS架构上的实验，SEAM在使用更少训练数据的情况下，达到了与基线相当的性能。

papers.title: Skeleton-Grounded Latent Action Model for Robot World Models
papers.abstract: Abstract SkeLAM decomposes latent actions into skeleton-guided kinematic and residual components to improve controllable robot world modeling and motion transfer.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Robot world models simulate how environments evolve in response to robot actions. Latent action models enable learning dynamics from videos by encoding visual transitions as proxy actions. However, reconstruction-driven latent actions mix robot motion with object responses and other scene changes, complicating their correspondence with robot controls. We propose SkeLAM, a skeleton-guided latent action model for controllable robot world modeling. SkeLAM decomposes latent actions into a kinematic component grounded by robot skeleton supervision and a residual component retaining complementary visual dynamics. Cross-modal swap reconstruction encourages RGB-derived and skeleton-derived kinematic representations to be interchangeable during video reconstruction. The world model incorporates both components through separate conditioning pathways, while branch dropout reduces its dependence on future-derived residual information. A lightweight adapter maps robot actions to the kinematic space, and subsequent world-model fine-tuning adapts generation to these predicted conditions. At inference, the model generates future observations from the current observation and robot actions. On DROID, SkeLAM reduces end-effector ADE by 19.5% and LPIPS by 11.1% compared with DreamDojo. Motion probing supports kinematic specialization, while qualitative results demonstrate zero-shot human-to-robot motion transfer in generated rollouts. Policy evaluation shows agreement between predicted success rates and those measured in real robot executions.

ru.title: Разделяй движение робота и мир вокруг, чтобы управлять симуляцией точнее
ru.desc: Статья представляет SkeLAM — модель латентных действий, направляемая скелетом робота, которая разделяет латентные действия на кинематическую компоненту (опирающуюся на скелетную supervision) и остаточную компоненту с дополнительной визуальной динамикой. Для повышения взаимозаменяемости представлений используется cross-modal swap reconstruction, а world model учитывает обе компоненты через отдельные пути conditioning и branch dropout. На бенчмарке DROID SkeLAM снижает ADE конечного эффектора на 19.5% и LPIPS на 11.1% по сравнению с DreamDojo, а также демонстрирует zero-shot перенос движений человека на робота. Оценка политик показывает согласованность предсказанных и реальных показателей успешности.

en.title: SkeLAM: Enhancing Robot Control through Skeleton-Guided Action Decomposition
en.desc: SkeLAM is a novel model that enhances robot world modeling by breaking down latent actions into two parts: a kinematic component guided by the robot's skeleton and a residual component that captures additional visual dynamics. This separation allows for clearer control over robot movements and better simulation of how environments react to these actions. By using cross-modal swap reconstruction, SkeLAM ensures that both RGB and skeleton data can be used interchangeably, improving the accuracy of video reconstructions. The model has shown significant improvements in performance metrics, demonstrating its effectiveness in enabling robots to predict and execute actions more accurately in real-world scenarios.

zh.title: SkeLAM：提升机器人运动控制的潜在动作模型
zh.desc: SkeLAM是一种骨架引导的潜在动作模型，旨在改善可控机器人世界建模和运动转移。它将潜在动作分解为基于机器人骨架的运动学组件和保留视觉动态的残差组件。通过交叉模态重建，SkeLAM鼓励RGB和骨架导出的运动学表示在视频重建中可互换。实验结果表明，SkeLAM在机器人执行中的成功率与预测结果一致，显著提高了机器人运动的控制能力。

papers.title: SplatLab: Autonomous Scientific Discovery for 3DGS Research
papers.abstract: Abstract SplatLab autonomously reproduces 3D Gaussian Splatting baselines, proposes extensions, and writes manuscripts with fully traceable training logs, improving PSNR by up to 3.78 dB.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Reproducing a published 3DGS paper takes weeks of expert engineering before any extension can be proposed. Prior autonomous-research systems read papers, draft hypotheses, and write code, but are limited by short fixed templates, low executability, and weak traceability, and none has been demonstrated end-to-end in a live computer-vision subfield with intense activity. SplatLab is an autonomous research system for 3D Gaussian Splatting that addresses these limitations. Given a research prompt, a target-paper URL, or no input at all, it reproduces a published baseline, proposes an extension, trains and ablates across Mip-NeRF 360 and LLFF, writes the manuscript, and binds every reported number to a logged training run. Five design choices distinguish it: (i) candidates mutate plugins from a verified-reproduction backbone matched to published baselines; (ii) a cascade-weighted Elo tournament across eight islands scores candidates on measured GPU PSNR with verbal-gradient feedback; (iii) a standing falsifier subtracts Elo on failure, integrating stress-test survival into selection; (iv) every reported number is bound to a logged training run, and the run cannot terminate while any claim is unbacked; (v) a seven-category 3DGS taxonomy wraps EVOLVE-BLOCK markers in domain-aligned scaffolds transferable across 3DGS repositories. On PSNR-targeted runs, SplatLab's manuscripts beat their reproduced targets by +0.18 to +3.78 dB, including +3.78 dB on astrophotographic nebula rendering, for which no prior 3DGS method exists. The research cycle compresses from months of graduate-student time to days of mostly autonomous compute. Code, all manuscripts, experiment ledgers, and the cross-run paper store are available on the project page.

ru.title: Автономный исследователь 3D-рендеринга: от воспроизведения до статьи за дни
ru.desc: SplatLab — это автономная исследовательская система для 3D Gaussian Splatting, которая сама воспроизводит опубликованные базовые методы и предлагает их расширения. Она оценивает кандидатов через Elo-турнир на реальных измерениях PSNR, а также использует «фальсификатор», снижающий рейтинг при провале стресс-тестов. Каждое число в статье привязано к логу обучения, поэтому результаты полностью прослеживаемы. В итоге цикл исследования сокращается с месяцев работы аспиранта до нескольких дней почти автономных вычислений, а на отдельных задачах метод улучшает PSNR до +3.78 dB.

en.title: Revolutionizing 3D Gaussian Splatting with Autonomous Research
en.desc: SplatLab is an autonomous research system designed for 3D Gaussian Splatting that significantly streamlines the research process. It can reproduce existing baselines, propose new extensions, and generate manuscripts with complete training logs, enhancing performance metrics like PSNR by up to 3.78 dB. Unlike previous systems, SplatLab operates end-to-end in a dynamic computer vision field, overcoming limitations in template rigidity and traceability. Its innovative design includes a mutation-based candidate selection, a scoring tournament for performance evaluation, and a robust logging system that ensures all results are verifiable and backed by training runs.

zh.title: SplatLab：自动化的 3D 高斯点云研究系统
zh.desc: SplatLab 是一个自主研究系统，专注于 3D 高斯点云的重现和扩展。它能够根据研究提示或目标论文 URL 自动重现已发布的基线，并提出扩展方案，同时记录每次训练的日志。该系统通过五个设计选择提高了研究的可执行性和可追溯性，显著提升了 PSNR 性能。SplatLab 将研究周期从几个月缩短到几天，极大地提高了计算效率。

papers.title: Realism VS Accuracy: Event Sequence Forecasting from a Generative Modeling Perspective
papers.abstract: Abstract Event sequence forecasting is evaluated as conditional generative modeling, revealing a trade-off between accuracy and realism, and a proposed algorithm converts realism into predictive accuracy.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Event sequences are chains of random events, each described by heterogeneous (numerical and categorical) features. The problem of event sequence forecasting occurs in finance, healthcare, business process intelligence, and other fields. In this work, we study multi-horizon forecasting of event sequences as a conditional generative modeling problem. We evaluate forecasts not only for prediction accuracy, but also for distributional realism. To this end, we present a benchmark comprising metrics for both quality aspects, strong statistical baselines, recent models adapted from adjacent fields, and curated real-world datasets. Careful evaluation reveals that no method excels at both accuracy and realism, highlighting a fundamental trade-off between the two. Finally, we introduce Wasserstein BaryBooster, an algorithm that aggregates samples from a realism-strong diffusion model into a state-of-the-art predictor, demonstrating that distributional realism can be converted into prediction accuracy. Code is available at https://github.com/xaosina/event-sequence-forecasting.

ru.title: Реалистичность прогноза можно превратить в точность
ru.desc: Статья рассматривает прогнозирование последовательностей событий как задачу условного генеративного моделирования, где нужно учитывать не только точность предсказаний, но и реалистичность распределения сгенерированных данных. Авторы создали бенчмарк с метриками обоих типов, сильными статистическими бейзлайнами, адаптированными моделями из смежных областей и реальными датасетами. Оказалось, что ни один метод не превосходит остальные одновременно по точности и реалистичности, что указывает на фундаментальный компромисс между ними. Предложенный алгоритм Wasserstein BaryBooster агрегирует сэмплы из диффузионной модели с высокой реалистичностью в предиктор, демонстрируя, что реалистичность распределения можно превратить в точность прогноза.

en.title: Balancing Accuracy and Realism in Event Sequence Forecasting
en.desc: This paper addresses the challenge of forecasting event sequences, which are series of events characterized by various features. It treats this problem as conditional generative modeling, emphasizing the balance between prediction accuracy and the realism of generated sequences. The authors introduce a new algorithm called Wasserstein BaryBooster, which enhances predictive accuracy by leveraging the realism from a diffusion model. Their findings reveal a trade-off between accuracy and realism, suggesting that improving one often compromises the other.

zh.title: 准确性与现实性的平衡：事件序列预测的新方法
zh.desc: 事件序列预测被视为条件生成建模，揭示了准确性与现实性之间的权衡。本文研究了事件序列的多时间段预测，并提出了一种新的算法Wasserstein BaryBooster，该算法能够将现实性转化为预测准确性。我们评估了预测结果，不仅关注预测的准确性，还关注其分布的现实性。通过建立基准和使用真实世界数据集，我们发现没有一种方法能够同时在准确性和现实性上表现出色。

papers.title: MambaAct: Efficient Mamba Action Experts for Flow-Matching Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Abstract MambaAct replaces the transformer action expert in flow-matching VLA policies with a compact Mamba-based expert and a context compressor to cut inference latency while improving robotic manipulation success.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Vision-language-action (VLA) models have shown strong promise for generalist robotic manipulation, but their inference cost remains a major bottleneck for real-time control. This limitation is especially pronounced in flow-matching VLAs such as π_{0.5}, where the action expert is evaluated repeatedly during iterative denoising. We introduce MambaAct, an efficient Mamba action expert for flow-matching VLA policies. MambaAct retains the pretrained visual-language prefix encoder of π_{0.5}, while replacing its transformer-based action expert with a compact Mamba-based action expert. Within this expert, Mamba serves as the action mixer that models dependencies across the noisy continuous-action sequence. To preserve visual-language conditioning without repeated token-level cross-attention, MambaAct uses a lightweight Context Compressor to map Vision-language model (VLM) prefix tokens into a compact conditioning signal that gates and modulates each Mamba action block. MambaAct uses a 10times smaller action expert and reduces flow-matching denoising latency by 64.8% on LIBERO and 58.8% in real-world deployment, while improving mean LIBERO success by 1.08 percentage points across three independent fine-tuning seeds and maintaining gains on LIBERO-Plus and real-world benchmarks. Our code and model weights are publicly available at https://github.com/giakhuyendihoc/MambaAct.

ru.title: Быстрее думать, точнее действовать: Mamba ускоряет роботов
ru.desc: Авторы предлагают MambaAct — эффективный action expert для flow-matching VLA-политик, который заменяет трансформер в действующей части модели на компактный Mamba-блок. Mamba моделирует зависимости внутри зашумлённой последовательности непрерывных действий, а визуально-языковой префикс сжимается в компактный сигнал через Context Compressor, который модулирует каждый блок. Благодаря action expert, который в 10 раз меньше, задержка денойзинга уменьшается на 64.8% в LIBERO и на 58.8% в реальных экспериментах. При этом средний успех на LIBERO растёт на 1.08 п.п., что подтверждается тремя независимыми сидами обучения.

en.title: MambaAct: Speeding Up Robotic Manipulation with Compact Action Experts
en.desc: MambaAct is a new approach that enhances flow-matching vision-language-action (VLA) policies by introducing a compact Mamba-based action expert. This method significantly reduces inference latency while improving the success rate of robotic manipulation tasks. By replacing the traditional transformer action expert with a more efficient Mamba expert and utilizing a Context Compressor, MambaAct maintains effective visual-language conditioning without the need for extensive cross-attention. The results show a substantial decrease in latency and an increase in performance, making it a promising solution for real-time robotic applications.

zh.title: MambaAct：提升机器人操作效率的创新方案
zh.desc: MambaAct是一种高效的动作专家，旨在提高流匹配视觉语言行动（VLA）策略的机器人操作成功率，同时降低推理延迟。它通过用紧凑的Mamba动作专家替换传统的变压器动作专家，并引入上下文压缩器来优化性能。MambaAct保留了预训练的视觉语言前缀编码器，并通过轻量级的上下文压缩器将视觉语言模型的前缀标记映射为紧凑的条件信号，从而减少了流匹配去噪的延迟。实验结果表明，MambaAct在多个基准测试中显著提高了成功率，并减少了推理时间。
